collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A builder is about to lift a heavy beam with an old rope that looks sound, but something about it bothers them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a builder, is about to lift a heavy beam with an old rope that looks sound, but something about it bothers them.

choices.label: Ask an Experienced Rope-Maker to Check It.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The new rope holds, and the builder later finds the old one rotten inside.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The replacement takes the morning, and the crew grumbles until the old rope snaps when tested.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The rope frays under a light load, and they replace it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The rope holds, but the builder replaces it anyway, to be safe.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The rope-maker finds hidden damage and recommends a new rope.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The rope-maker says it is fine, and the builder still uses two ropes together.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The beam rises safely with extra hands.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The extra supports make the lift slow and clumsy, but no one is hurt.
